+        "execution_bindings": sorted(digest(c["view"]["binding"]) for c in chains),
+        "execution_constraints": sorted(digest(c["view"]["effective_constraints"]) for c in chains),

+

+def derive_comparability(a3: Mapping[str, Any], a4: Mapping[str, Any], *,
+                         admitted_skill_count: int) -> dict[str, Any]:

+            "supply_boundaries", "execution_bindings", "execution_constraints"}
